Meshal Alharbi

Massachusetts Institute of Technology

Meshal Alharbi is pursuing a PhD in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS) at MIT, with prior dual master’s degrees in Computational Science and Engineering and EECS from MIT. His research sits at the intersection of statistical machine learning, optimization, and control, with a current focus on sample-efficient reinforcement learning for control and decision-making — contributing to SCHEMA’s scalable multi-agent decision-making.
